reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Eight hard weeks is right around when most people are due one. Signs it's time: lifts stalling or slipping, warm-ups feeling heavy, sleep or mood sliding, or motivation dropping. If you're seeing a couple of those, take a lighter week with about half the sets at the same weights. If you feel strong and your numbers are still climbing, keep going. How have your lifts been moving?"}
